The '''Askajian language''' was the native language of the [[Askajian/Legends|Askajians]], who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Askaji/Legends|Askaj]]. The word "[[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna]]" in this language meant "beautiful."
